notes.title: More features & languages
notes.content:
Mooncastle is at version 1.0.16 now and has undergone a lot of changes and fixes.

There is a help section in the Moon Castle website in case you need help solving the puzzles. Also there is a feature that you can use to return to the last saved Safe Restore Point by using this command:

xsrp[enter]

More changes that have been added are:
- The rendering quality can now be changed to low, medium, high or epic
- The speed of walking can be changed
- Several other fixes

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32149271/ad28755cbe65e9791775722d02e4d4d93100a029.png[/img]

Support for more languages will be added soon. Dutch is already supported and will be followed by German.

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32149271/455faa50b7ff5f15b7e21d09f6e366a7972a616b.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32149271/60cbb91df5fb73f031e3307c2570939d2492e1e9.png[/img][/url]

Also VR support is in the pipeline, starting with the Oculus Rift!
